review_description: Very good service all round.Phil explained the upcoming battery rebate and I got a hybrid inverter for not much more.

I decided to undertake the daunting challenge of getting solar panels installed. I had delayed for many years due to shading from a double storey house next door. After reviewing the excellent website SolarQuotes I made an enquiry to 5 companies in December 2024. I chose Formula Sun because of the excellent communication, knowledge and honesty. Phil gave me full value of the STCs at 2025 rates which in fact worked out to be more than what the other companies were offering anyway.The product Phil offered me were excellent quality so I booked him in. Come installation day the installers were excellent. Job completed in about 4 hours all neat and tidy. System installed and working well.In short, Formula Sun are an honest company, offer great value, quality products, excellent communication and knowledge. I am very happy I chose Formula Sun and highly recommend them to anyone who wants to install a solar system.

I had great service from this company and it only took 2 weeks. From a nice easy to read quote without dozens of attachments like the others, to turning up on time and leaving everything neat.Dealing direct with a smaller business with years of experience an hassle free service is a pleasure hard to find at times today.Installers where mature experience tradies who actually worked hard ,an in on 39° day.Recommend highly.S

We had great service from this company and it only took 2 weeks. From a nice easy to read quote without dozens of attachments like the others, to turning up on time and leaving everything neat. Way more solar than we need right now but thinking of an electric car in the future.
I am happy with this companies service, we puchased 6.6kW as advised and it has exeeded expectations, very professional.

We had a good experience with this company, we went for TW panels and Fronius inverter. Pre-installation was fast and Phil kept us informed of the process. The two guys turned up as arranged and really seemed to know what they were doing, set up the wifi and cleaned up. I even went up on the roof for a look and all seemed very neat.

A friend recommended FS and we had a good experience. The quote was good but similar to others. Install only took around 2 weeks. System is making around 20 units per day in mid winter so as predicted in quote.We have had some storms and no leaks so far.All in all a good experience and I will be recommending to others.

I went with 18 x Longi 370 watt Panels. I changed from Goodwe to SMA which they were happy to do and we had a smart meter thrown in....Had them installed on 4/1/21The installers were also great and were happy to rejig the configuration of panel layout. Left with everything tidy and Brett was very helpful with setting up smart meter - Yes it was working when installedPania from Formula sun organised the new Western Power meter and chased it up after discovering thatSynergy did not process a Work Order for Western Power to change meter out, which resulted in a delayI am having problems getting the SMA smart meter to work on my mobile & computer. Formula sun have sent a technician but still not fixed. He was supposed to come again this week but COVID shut down has put a halt on this.pania has been following up on it with me
Great experience getting solar from Phil Mercer and team.On time, all organized by PaniaFitting crew guys were quick efficient and tidy.Thanks Formula sun.

Very helpful, explained things factually and objectively, well priced. The people I spoke with weren't annoying salesman trying hard to push a sale, they were just knowledgable and factual. Shared lots of details of different solar systems and why they use the brands that they do. Great company and would recommend.

Installation went OK and was generating power from day 1 but there was a problem connecting the inverter to my Wifi to provide data reporting. This took several visits and probably about 12-15 hours on site to resolve and turned out to be a faulty Huawei wifi dongle – system connected fine once this was swapped but was almost 3 months later.

We had virtually the same experience as the review on this site by Sarah. Formula Sun did not complete the necessary paperwork for Synergy and Western Power, although I did send numerous follow up emails and messages to Formula Sun. Thus the system was not registered..Formula Sun emailed me numerous times advising that the registration was completed. When following up further I got plenty of promises that they would ring me back. I did not get any return calls.I was aware the Synergy had not changed the meter and thus in desperation finally contacted them directly. They advised me that the Distributed Energy Buyback Scheme (DEBS) application had not been completed by Formula Sun. Synergy were excellent and helped me fill out the application. I then contacted Western Power who informed me that the form should have been completed PRIOR to installation. Western Power were fantastic and helped me a lot, so after a delay of 7 weeks the new meter was installed.Whilst the installation was good the whole saga was extremely stressful and upsetting at times. I would not recommend this company at all as the pre and post installation customer service has been appalling to say the least.
Good system good price my lady friend also got the same system through formula sun

Hard to know the quality of the install without going on the roof. Office line was helpful in answering questions on what to select. It was done only a couple of days after agreeing to proceed which was great. Wasn’t much time spent by the installers in terms of explaining the system but will call formula sun once get full billing period covered by the solar.
Timely , good value for money and regular communication between office and on the ground installers and follow up work

Dealt with Pharnia who was helpful throughout. I had a good idea what I wanted and discussed this; I found her input and guidance useful. Pharnia organised the grid connection and again that process went smoothly.The actual installation went well and I was pleased with the two guys who completed the work. I felt there was a care factor and they took pride in what they did.Everything has worked satisfactorily since the installation and I would have no hesitation in recommending Formula Sun
It was an easy process from start to finish.The installation was quick efficient and they arrived on time and were very professional and quicker than anticipated.

Quoting process was handled online. Formula Sun provided all the details for my review and answered all my questions.The installation was completed efficiently on the scheduled date in approximately 4-5 hours.Unfortunately the grid connection was not timed to coincide with the solar installation and I had to wait another 4 weeks due to the Xmas break. Considering the life of the system, it was a minor inconvenience.
Easy to deal with If system is as good as Tristan and Aaron were on the install it will be great!  Great service all the way around

The company provided a quote very quickly after request.  Customer service is great.  Were able to answer all my questions over the telephone. Offered a number of dates for installation.  Price was very competitive with other quotes.  Installation was fantastic, the tradesmen were very professional, arrived  on time, neat tidy work and answered all my questions. Grid connection has still not occurred although advised by Formula Sun they have contacted Western Power twice.  I trust they will continue to follow up this until resolved.  I recommend this company.
Quick installation, all good. A bit less “professional” in the sales process than competitors.
Great customer service and very professional installation. The whole process was very easy with Formula Sun

The whole process was prompt and detailed by email (using Google earth and Nearmap - no site visit ) but I did order a Fronius inverter and was expecting installation of to be in the garage. I asked do they need to inspect before as I perceived access would not be straight forward but was told not necessary.Unfortunately when it came to installation they couldn't get cable access from garage to the switch board so they inverter had to be mounted externally on a side wall with some surface conduiting and they installed a Goodwe inverter.The installers were very good and did a great job in minimising surface conduit and job was very neat and they installed a shade structure over the inverter.Overall the system is working as expected and the inverter would have been external using other companies.Would recommend Formula Sun to others but get a site visit by the installer before signing off.

Sales / quoting was prompt and polite.Install was arranged quickly.Installation went without a hitch. The panels are positioned so they are not visible from the front of our house as requested.The inverter unit was positioned well also.No mess was left behind.Customer service was great. A very smooth process. We are very happy and highly recommend Formula Sun.

Wasn't seemless but these things rarely are. Only weird thing is a Formula Sun use a mans buisiness email (assume the owner) yet never actually dealt with him in any way, always dealt with a lovely helpful lady that coordinated the job just fine. All in all happy with the system for the price and I added an extra job for the installer that was catered for with no fuss. Install was nice and neat, happy with the result. Would recommend.

Following the prompts from Solarquotes I got contacts, plus a few others from my own research. I narrowed down my choice of inverter and panels from the reviews, and other sources, and finally chose Formula Sun to do the job, even though my contact with them did not go well. The final decision was made based on them being able to supply the hardware and the rave reviews for their installers. I was not disappointed. They arrived on time, made adjustments to the plan as  the panels ( 19 of them split between east and west facing roof surfaces) were different sizes on the plan! Todd and partner expertly adjusted the plan and made them all fit. They worked quickly (in 40c + temps) and finished on time.

The team contacted me straight away. My roof is shaded.  I was told exactly how many solar panels I would need. no sales pitches to buy bigger or better. How the panels would work was explained to in clear and concise terms.Installers were polite and explained exactly want they were doing to my roof.Overall the experience was painless and the team were friendly and honest.  Well done

Having asked for quotes through this website, this company were the only ones to send a fact sheet and a quote without the hassle of a site visit and a pushy salesperson which is the one thing I dreaded happening.After being happy with the original quote I expressed some resignations that perhaps my roof being a smaller than average size, may not fit the original quote. Pania arranged the installers they use to site visit and he expertly gave me his opinion and a different panel design was offered with slightly smaller panels.Due to this the quote was revised slightly cheaper and after some time to persuade my wife that solar was the way forward and cost effective I was able to give the go ahead.The install date was swift(withing the week), Pania and Phil organised the changeover of the meter with Synergy/Western Power, and the day of install the meter was changed over and the 2 gents installing did a stellar install and I couldn't be happier with my installFor reference JA solar panels(due to delivery delays my original Risen panels were unavailable) and a Goodwe inverter.The installers got my inverter onto my wifi inverter, the app downloaded, and I am now obsessed with looking at the KWs my panels are generating every day since!I would have absolutely no hesitation recommending Formula sun for this install and the products so far so good!Thanks again guysGareth

Everyone we dealt with was extremely courteous and helpful.  The installers were very polite and tidy and helpfulThere were a couple of unexpected hiccups but they were dealt with promptly and efficiently and we are very happy with the end result.

The engagement with Phil and the team was a pleasure. The team sent out did a fantastic job and I was very impressed with their workmanship and how they were able to meet our aesthetic requirements. Their solution was also excellent value for money.

We recently had a solar system installed.  We're happy with the performance of the system so far, and pleased with the quality of the work done by the installers.  They took the time to ensure the cabling and installation did not detract from the street appeal of our home.

Non-pushy quotation. Install was good, could have tidied up the roof a little better but not bad. Communication by email seemed a bit rushed but generally responsive.Great communication on the phone with the install team regarding position/layout of modules and inverter.

Phil at Formula Sun was receptive to my questions and helpful in achieving hot water diversion in the most cost effective way for me. The process was low friction and we went from quote to result with hardly a thing to stress about. Great service :)

The initial contact with Formula Sun was informative and helpfulThere was some miscommunication within the office re installation plans which caused me to reconsider my options.I went ahead with using Formula Sun after further discussion. Seamless sales experience, very informative and not pushy. Installation was quick, punctual and the installer had a good attention to detail. Customer service ws exceptional.

I requested a couple of quotes through solarquotes on a recent Friday, one being Formula Solar.First tick - Phil from Formula Solar responded that Saturday with a couple of options and layout of the best panel arrangement, a super quick turn around from the quote request. I waited for the second quote to come through for comparison sake and also reached out to synergy for a quote as well.Second tick - After doing some thorough research I decided I would like to pick different panels and inverter to the ones suggested by Phil, I suggested the change to both companies that quoted, Formula Solar rapidly replied that they were happy to supply both the panels and inverter that I had chosen. The other company would not change the panels as they had a set brand.Third tick - After a bit of backwards and forwards with quotes and the like, Formula Sun on Monday let me know they had a vacancy for an install on that Thursday - happy days. Formula Sun also listened to explanation of inverter location and upgraded the AC cable to accommodate.Fourth Tick - the install was super easy, the installer arrived on time, listened to where I wanted the inverter, placing it in exactly the right spot and also listened to my slight change in panel layout location, happily going ahead with what I had requested. The installation was completed quickly and easily with no mess left behind, Its a great neat job too.Fifth Tick - the after sales contact from Phil has been great as well - even recently asking for log in details to check the inverter is working correctly.I have absolutely no hesitation on recommending these guys - even if you're like me and think "you only get what you pay for - the more expensive guys are obviously better" not in this instance, that's for sure!Hint - if you are wanting to track your power in and out, get them to install a power meter - my inverter is a Fronius - so a Fronius Smart meter means I can see how much I am using and how much I am generating.My days are now filed with constantly checking my solar gainz, turning appliances on and off to see the effect on power drain - it's been great to have something to do while taking a break from working from home due to COVID-19!

They were very quick to respond to the request for quote and the price was reasonable. Easy to deal with, polite, helpful, and the installers were a delight to have in the house. A great job done.

Installation within days by good installers who went the extra mile to do some complex wiring to set up the inverter as we requested. Tidy, polite, punctual.

Formula Sun were fast responsive and able to explain things for us if we needed more clarification. easy as pie, great system, really happy.  Formula Sun was referred to me and i have subsequently recommended to 2 more people

I was very satisfied with the quote and the professionalism with the installation process. I subsequently had a slight problem with power to my bore which had been interrupted. Within 48 hours of my notifying Formula Sun the issue was resolved. The gentlemen  with whom I dealt were very professional, informative and respectful.

I have no problems in recommending Formula Sun Solar. Phil was helpful and fully explained what was going to happen, I received emails describing everything that was going to happen.The Guys who installed our Solar were great and helped me understand all the required information on how the Solar Panels and Inverter  worked.They were 1.5 hours early for installation, I was very happy with that.The customer service is amazing.Well done to a wonderful team, plus the followup emails were awesome too.
Extra effort to give a call on the weekend to answer my questions
- Quick quoting process: only took 1-2 days to get a quote. From there, installation happened 2 weeks from accepting the quote.

Ordered 2x6.6kw systems.  One for me and 2nd for sister.  Both used fanless Goodwe inverter and Longi 315W solar panels.  System generating around 43kw to 45kw per day on sunny cloud free days since installed.  Cloudy or wet days I get above 30kw.Web app easy to set up and use which shows instant and total generation via graph and number and accessibility via internet anywhere. Was easy dealing with formula sun and discussed inverter in detail.  Goodwe cheaper and as reliable as others.  Big difference is fanless cooling which improves reliability (ie no moving parts).  Did almost buy more expensive inverter but after research realised wasnt any better.In terms of panels, Longi seemed to have best price / reliability equation.  Less output loss than other panels offered.  Dyor though!Other point was I discussed in detail location of panels as wanted morning and afternoon sun.  No issues just remember to discuss when you buy the system.

I found Formula Sun to be interested in making sure I had all my questions answered and responded very promptly (I received responses to questions on weekends!). The installation team made sure that I was happy with the placement of the Inverter and were done in half the time I expected, even working through on a miserably damp day.I would happily recommend Formula Sun.

Friendly, professional installers and everything put exactly where the quote said it would go.  One small issue with a foxtel antenna so if your installer asks to move an antenna, make sure they dont actually mean remove.

We have been wanting solar on our new home and got the 3 quotesFormula Sun listened to our concerns, advised and adjusted the system to suitthe installation was not simple but the team site assess the best options and discussed it further before going ahead very efficiently. The quote was competitive and installed within a few weeks. They gave honest advice on the best system to suit my home. Installers were quick and clean. The basics of the system were explained. Couldnâ€™t ask for anymore. Looks to have reduced my bill by 2/3.

We haven't received any bills since installation so hard to assess quality of the system and value for money but i'm optimistic that all is good.  Installation went ok.  I was not happy with electricians initial thoughts on installing visible pipes along my walls but was very happy when they agreed they could hide these inside our cupboards and behind a downpipes (but due to extra effort he said it would take him 2 days to install rather than 1).  Unfortunately he slightly cut through one of our Air Conditioner electrical wires and our A/C stopped working.  Formula sun did not respond very urgently to this and I had to call him back again later that day to get their Electrician back out.  To his credit electrician came out and admitted he had put a slight cut through a wire but said that by all accounts it should still be working. I then had to get the A/C company out to find that he had shorted out a switch inside the A/C unit. So a simple fix was all that was needed, but just annoying and time consuming chasing up trades/companies. The fist people we dealt with at Formula sun, a young lady and another man were great and informative, however we found the owner to be less attentive, needed following up and after paying for the system in full it has taken them just a few days short of a month to finally send through our User manual, warranty and other details (and some details were incorrect on one form).

The whole process was made so easy. Phil and team quoted an extremely reasonable price right from the start with all related information included and no 'hard' sales pitch. They are also extremely knowledgeable.The installation team arrived on time and were clean and tidy and efficient. The products are working like a dream.I couldn't be happier.Thank you Formula Sun!

Fantastic service from Phil and Tom.They answered all questions promptly and honestly and provided professional expertise.Their quote was very competitive, equipment supplied is of high quality and installation was on time and is very neat and tidy.Installer even helped me to set up an app on my smartphone so I can monitor power consumption whenever I want.Formula Sun is a local business and I highly recommend them.

Sales and quoting was informative and not pushy.Installation was punctual with the only issue was of the installers walking over my pool solar heating which I asked specifically not too - however that issue was followed up by Formula Sun promptly.
Sales and quoting was easy and informative. Scheduling and coordination of install was quick and the installers did an excellent job

The design and selection process took a bit of time due to a) designing a system that met my requirements, and then b) finding out at the last minute that the house I had just moved into had a 3-phase electricity supply instead of a 1-phase supply, as I had thought. This affected the design of other systems I had been quoted on, because of the selection of inverters to provide the level of production & consumption monitoring & reporting that I wanted.Throughout all of this, Phil at Formula Sun patiently answered all my questions and ended up installing a better system that he had originally designed and quoted me. It was a little more expensive but worth it for the level of monitoring and reporting. Formula Sun handled all the paperwork with Synergy and Western Power. The actual installation went relatively smoothly.At the time of writing this, there are a couple of relatively minor outstanding issues that I expect will be resolved soon. However, the system is generating more power than I expected, even on cloudy & rainy days, which will help pay for it sooner.
Very professional in terms of pricing and system selection. Disappointed in loction of panels during installation as do not get optimal sun exposure.
From quote to install there were no hassles. Heaps of impartial info provided. Installers were super efficient and even swept up.

Once we agreed to go ahead and set a date all we had to do was wait, everything was taken care of.Installation day came & went according to plan using the materials as quoted without any hitches and they left me virtually no mess to clean up!Completely satisfied with the overall process and we are looking forward to the future power cost savings.

The quote was quick and detailedThe installation was quick and very professional.I asked a few questions after installation and formula sun responded quickly and were willing to help.I also recommended them to my colleague and his service was also great.

From start to finish a great job with Phil and his team at Formula Sun, have already recommended them to my friends.

The information on the Solar Quotes website was very helpful and a great place to start. We chose Formula Sun for our solar needs for the following reasons:1. their pricing was very competitive and reasonable;2. they don't use external contractors to undertake the installation;3. they had good customer service - I met with the owner of the business who was very knowledgeable, informative and honest, and he made some good recommendations to suit my needs (eg. suggesting the Longi panels with the black frames so that the panels would blend in with my charcoal coloured roof and are less visible); and4. they had good ratings from various sources.Formula Sun were the first to contact us and were very friendly from the outset. We received numerous quotes (from Solar Quotes and other sources) and Formula Sun was very well priced for the same package offered by the various suppliers. The cheapest quote we received was from another provider which used external contractors (which may use inferior materials for the electricals and are often ones that encourage installation of the inverter near the meterbox to save on costs). The most expensive quote we received came from a service provider that was exceptional, professional and very informative, and their electricians are employees. But the price was too high for us and on the balance, Formula Sun offered a similar service but relatively lower price for the same package.Formula Sun's installers were very friendly, respectful and considerate. They accommodated all my preferences in terms of placement of the panels and conduits in a way that wasn't visible from the street front and they were able to install the inverter in my garage (at no extra charge). The owner of the business also attended my property on the morning of the installation to ensure that the installation complied with my requirements and that I was happy with the placement of the panels and inverter. I was consulted throughout the entire process. They also returned later to trim the length of the railings when I thought they were too long and visible (from the back of the house). I would highly recommend them and am pleased to have selected them to install our solar system.

SolarQuotes made the job of obtaining three quotes extremely simple. We chose Phil from FormulaSun. His easy going no pressure approach made it a pleasure to deal with. My only regret is not getting solar earlier!

Just had a 6.6kW system with 21 panels installed this week.  The service from Phil at Formula Sun was excellent right from the first contact.  He explained the differences in the components offered and the benefits of each system.  Formula Sun took care of all applications to Western Power & Synergy.  3 weeks later I have a fully functioning system installed.  Installation went smoothly, no issues and only took about 5 hours.  Time will tell regarding how much I will save by early indications are good!  Price was great too!

Good experience from the beginning, Phil was easy to talk too and answered all my questions. Went with the Fronius Primo inverter and Longi Panels. Neat job from installers and no mess left behind, had trouble connecting the smart meter to Solar.web to begin contacted Phil and installer come and rectified straight away. Happy with the finished outcome thanks Formular Sun and Thank you solarquotes.

Phil was very quick with the detailed quote (same day) and the SolarQuotes vetting form was already completed in the documentation.  I was initially concerned that no site visit was carried out but after sending a photo of my switchboard and talking to Tom on the phone I realized there probably is no need for a standard install and it's one of the ways these guys keep their costs down.Installation day the guys turned up on time and got into it. Leon was happy to move the position of a couple of panels from the original plan and agreed on a good place for the Inverter. The guys were very polite and professional. When Leon went to fit the isolation breaker to our switchboard, he found that a previous electrician had taken some shortcuts so he spent extra time tidying up the wiring for us. When the guys left, the Inverter was generating and I could see all the info on my iPhone. Have not had to call them since.The installation looks good to me - I went up into our roof after they left and everything looks properly done. After the install, Phil sends and email with an Instruction manual, serial numbers & wiring diagram for the installation.The install was only last week so still getting used to the system but so far I'm very happy with Formula Sun and SolarQuotes. 5stars in all categories might seem a bit over the top but I can't really fault them in any way. I would definitely recommend them to friends & family.Brian

Install job was done with no issues.the guys were really helpful with some broken tiles that were there before the install begun, helped me by moving them to a new spot.Super fast, no mess.Would recommend.
At all stages through the process from quote to install Phil and his team were excellent. Highly recommended.
